digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and author guides
propositions: Author-facing plan guide must explain that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after a slow codified delivery loop should be de-risked with fast out-of-loop proof before committing to the loop.
Fast proof forms permitted are either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, with cleanup scoped only to resources created by the throwaway experiment.
The packaged guide must identify the new de-risk guidance as T15 and regenerate criterion-pins.json to include the new criterion.
Documentation must update from stale T1–T12 range to validated T1–T15 range and report 44 total criteria, aligning hand-authored docs, registry module docstring, and validation output.
All guidance must remain stack-agnostic and must not hardcode product-specific tools like Terraform or Docker.
